app.name: MoneyFollows · Staff
app.crash: This page didn't load properly. That can happen after an update or when the connection drops. Reload the page to carry on.
topbar.sign_out_failed: Couldn't sign out. Check your connection and try again.
setup.title: Connect the dashboard to the backend
setup.body: This build has no backend settings, so staff can't sign in yet. Add these two values to the .env file at the repo root (copy .env.example), then restart the dashboard.
setup.vercel: On Vercel, add the same two as project environment variables and redeploy.
staffcheck.failed: We couldn't check your account. Check your connection and try again.
notstaff.title: You're signed in, but not on the staff list
notstaff.body: Your account isn't on the staff list yet. Ask the MoneyFollows admin to add you.
signin.title: Staff sign-in
signin.intro: Sign in with your email address and password.
signin.password_hint: At least 8 characters. Write it down somewhere safe.
signin.signup.title: Create your staff account
signin.signup.intro: Use the email address the MoneyFollows admin added to the staff list, and choose a password. You only do this once.
signin.signup.confirm: Account created. We sent an email to {{email}}: open it and confirm, then sign in here.
signin.forgot.title: Forgot your password?
signin.forgot.intro: Type your email address. We'll email you a link to choose a new password.
signin.forgot.sent: If {{email}} has a staff account, a link is on its way. Open the email (check the Spam folder too) and tap the button in it. The link works for 1 hour.
signin.reset.title: Choose a new password
signin.reset.intro: Choose a new password for your staff account. From now on, you sign in with it.
signin.demo_note: Local development only: demo.facilitator@example.org, password paisa-demo-2026.
signin.link_error: That link has expired or was already used. Sign in with your password, or tap "Forgot password?" for a new link.
signin.err.email: Enter a valid email address, for example name@gmail.com.
signin.err.password_short: The password needs at least 8 characters.
signin.err.wrong_password: That email and password don't match. Check both, or tap "Forgot password?".
signin.err.not_invited: This email isn't on the staff list yet. Ask the MoneyFollows admin to add it, then try again.
signin.err.account_exists: This email already has an account. Sign in instead, or tap "Forgot password?".
signin.err.weak_password: Choose a longer password: at least 8 characters.
signin.err.link_invalid: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
signin.err.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
signin.err.network: Can't reach the server. Check your internet and try again.
signin.err.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
signin.err.send_failed: We couldn't send the email. Try again in a few minutes, or tell the admin.
signin.err.demo: The demo account only exists on a local Supabase. Sign in with your own email and password.
sample.banner: Sample data. This is a made-up school for trying out the dashboard: no real students, and nothing you change is saved. Its class codes and QR codes are made up too, so they won't work in the student app.
sample.try_body: See how the dashboard works with a made-up school of 5 classes. No sign-up needed, and nothing is saved.
sample.hint: Sample data: type any email address and any password. Nothing is sent or saved.
nav.label: Class sections
classes.title: Your classes
classes.intro: Each class has a code. Students type it (or scan the QR) to join. This dashboard only ever shows nicknames.
classes.err.load: We couldn't load your classes. Check your connection and try again.
classes.search_hint: Type a class name or code
classes.empty.title: No classes yet
classes.empty.body: Create your first class above. You'll get a code and a QR to share.
classes.created: Class created: {{name}}. Share the code or QR below with your students.
classes.created_code_only: Class created: {{name}}. Give your students the class code below.
classes.no_student_url: Join links are switched off. This build doesn't know the student app's web address, so QR codes, links and printed sheets would point to the wrong place. Set VITE_STUDENT_URL to the address students open the app at, then redeploy. Until then, give students the class code to type in.
classes.create.title: Create a class
classes.create.name: Class name
classes.create.name_hint: For example: Class 11 A, Evening batch
classes.create.err.long: Keep the name to 80 characters or fewer.
classes.create.err.failed: We couldn't create the class. Check your connection and try again.
class.copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
sheet.title: Join MoneyFollows
sheet.step1: Open the link below or scan the QR code with your phone.
sheet.step2: Type a nickname. Please don't use your real name.
sheet.step3: Pick a character and start playing.
sheet.link: Or type this link in your browser:
sheet.code_note: If the app asks for a class code, type the code above.
settings.err: We couldn't save that change. Check your connection and try again.
settings.join.title: Joining
settings.join.body: Close the class to stop new students joining. Students already in the class keep playing and syncing.
settings.endline.title: End check
settings.endline.body: Opens the end-of-course check in the students' School. Turn it on when the course ends. Learning gains compare it with each student's start check.
settings.code.title: Class code
settings.code.body: If the code was shared too widely, get a new one. Printed sheets and QR codes with the old code stop working for new students. Students already in the class keep playing.
settings.code.confirm_body: The old code, and any printed sheet or QR that uses it, will stop working for new students. Students already in the class are not affected. You will need to print a new join sheet.
settings.code.changed: New class code: {{code}}. Print a new join sheet for your students.
